    export function usePromotionsSettings() {
      const [promotions, setPromotions] = useState<Promotion[]>([]);
      const [form, setForm] = useState<PromotionFormState>(EMPTY_PROMOTION_FORM);
      const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
      const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
      const [actionId, setActionId] = useState<string | null>(null);

      const loadPromotions = useCallback(async () => {
        setIsLoading(true);

          const data = await getPromotions();

        } catch (error) {

          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }, []);

        const timeoutId = window.setTimeout(() => {
          void loadPromotions();
        }, 0);

        return () => window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
      }, [loadPromotions]);

      const updateForm = useCallback((patch: Partial<PromotionFormState>) => {
        setForm((currentForm) => ({ ...currentForm, ...patch }));
      }, []);

      const handleSubmit = useCallback(async (event: FormEvent) => {
        event.preventDefault();

        if (!form.title.trim() || !form.description.trim()) {
          toast.error('Vui l├▓ng nhß║¡p ─æß║ºy ─æß╗º ti├¬u ─æß╗ü v├á m├┤ tß║ú.');
          return;
        }

        setIsSubmitting(true);
        try {
          const promotionPayload = buildPromotionPayload({
            title: form.title.trim(),
            description: form.description.trim(),
            discount_code: form.discountCode.trim() || null,
            discount_percent: form.discountPercent,
            start_date: form.startDate || null,
            end_date: form.endDate || null,
            is_active: true,
          });

          if (!promotionPayload.success) {
            toast.error(promotionPayload.error);
            return;
          }

          const result = await createPromotion(promotionPayload.payload);

          if (!result.success) {
            toast.error(`Lß╗ùi khi th├¬m khuyß║┐n m├úi: ${result.error}`);
            return;
          }

          toast.success('─É├ú th├¬m ch╞░╞íng tr├¼nh khuyß║┐n m├úi th├ánh c├┤ng.');
          setForm(EMPTY_PROMOTION_FORM);
          await loadPromotions();
        } catch (error) {
          toast.error(`Lß╗ùi kh├┤ng mong muß╗æn: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
        } finally {
          setIsSubmitting(false);
        }
      }, [form, loadPromotions]);

      const handleToggleActive = useCallback(async (promotion: Promotion) => {
        const nextStatus = !promotion.is_active;
        setActionId(promotion.id);
        try {
          const result = await togglePromotionActive(promotion.id, nextStatus);
          if (!result.success) {
            toast.error(`Kh├┤ng thß╗â cß║¡p nhß║¡t trß║íng th├íi: ${result.error}`);
            return;
          }

          setPromotions((currentPromotions) =>
            currentPromotions.map((item) =>
              item.id === promotion.id ? { ...item, is_active: nextStatus } : item
            )
          );
          toast.success(nextStatus ? '─É├ú k├¡ch hoß║ít ch╞░╞íng tr├¼nh.' : '─É├ú tß║ím ng╞░ng ch╞░╞íng tr├¼nh.');
        } catch (error) {
          toast.error(`Lß╗ùi: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
        } finally {
          setActionId(null);
        }
      }, []);

      const handleDelete = useCallback(async (promotion: Promotion) => {
        if (!confirm('Bß║ín c├│ chß║»c chß║»n muß╗æn x├│a ch╞░╞íng tr├¼nh khuyß║┐n m├úi n├áy kh├┤ng?')) return;

        setActionId(promotion.id);
        try {
          const result = await deletePromotion(promotion.id);
          if (!result.success) {
            toast.error(`Lß╗ùi khi x├│a khuyß║┐n m├úi: ${result.error}`);
            return;
          }

          setPromotions((currentPromotions) =>
            currentPromotions.filter((item) => item.id !== promotion.id)
          );
          toast.success('─É├ú x├│a ch╞░╞íng tr├¼nh khuyß║┐n m├úi th├ánh c├┤ng.');
        } catch (error) {
          toast.error(`Lß╗ùi: ${getErrorMessage(error)}`);
        } finally {
          setActionId(null);
        }
      }, []);

      return {
        promotions,
        form,
        isLoading,
        isSubmitting,
        actionId,
        updateForm,
        handleSubmit,
        handleToggleActive,
        handleDelete,
      };
    }
